primitives.name: Trench Conditional Chain Generation
primitives.verbatim_quote: # BRIEFING — 2026-10-18T14:06:00Z ## Mission Investigate and map Requirement 2 (R2): 14/14 Specific Receiver-vs-Corner & Trench Matchup Reports, diagnose 0-chain games, inspect data feeds, and create an implementation blueprint.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C': 'chain count per game', 'M': 'matchup set size', 'T': 'trench condition indicator'}
primitives.assumptions: Each game has exactly 14 matchups; trench conditions are binary indicators.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T=0, C=0; when T=1, C≥4.

layer2.mapping: Chain generation function f(M,T) → C maps to GSI's probabilistic state update and GSE's deterministic transition logic.
layer2.telemetry: Number of valid chains generated per game.

primitives.name: Receiver-Corner Duality Diagnosis
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Root causes identified: premature `break` in receiver loop (`matchup_engine.py:287`), dead `cov_out` code, one-sided trench analysis requiring DL injuries, and unnormalized team aliases (`WAS` vs `WSH`, `3800` vs `AZ` vs `ARI`).
primitives.assumptions: D depends on R, C, and I; injury status affects duality resolution.

layer2.mapping: Dual vector space of receiver and corner positions defines diagnostic kernel K(R,C) = ∫ P(R|C)P(C|R)dRdC.
layer2.telemetry: Diagnostic confidence level from matched pair analysis.

primitives.name: Data Feed Integrity Verification
primitives.verbatim_quote: - 100% of data is present locally across all 28 Week 6 teams in 2026 in-season NGS, ESPN depth charts, ESPN Week 6 injuries, and LineStar DvP.
primitives.assumptions: F = D(T)/D_max(T); F=1 implies full coverage.
primitives.breakdown_regime: F<1 indicates missing data; F=1 ensures full validation.

layer2.mapping: Integrity check function I(F) → {valid, invalid} aligns with GSI's data consistency model and GSE's input validation protocol.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of expected data present in local storage.

It operates under the assumption that each of the 14 matchups contributes at least four distinct chain states, which are derived from receiver-corner positional dynamics. The 'receiver_corner_duality_diagnosis' primitive serves as a kernel function that evaluates the alignment of receiver and corner roles, with injury status acting as a perturbation parameter. This diagnosis is critical because it determines whether the trench condition T is active, thereby triggering the chain generation mechanism. The 'data_feed_integrity_verification' ensures that all necessary inputs—NGS, depth charts, injury reports—are complete before any computation proceeds, maintaining the integrity of the system's state space. These primitives form a closed-loop system where diagnostics inform chain generation, which in turn validates data integrity.
